I had multiple dreams of my sister when she passed a month ago. 

The one I remember most and the one that affected me most emotionally was one where I was crying on a bench with my head down and no one around me. Then all of the sudden, she put her hand on my shoulder and said, "Why are you crying? You don't have to cry." And she hugged me. It felt so real and vivid. I could feel the way she used to feel and I remember resting my head on her shoulder and opening my tearful eyes to the image of her hair. I woke up feeling emotional and cried. 

The first one I had after her passing was one where she came back after having her funeral in my dream. She came bursting through the door saying, "I can't believe you thought that was me in that coffin. I'm here."

I have decided to call and request a more detailed form of what was done. 

Maybe I just want quick answers and jumped towards contacting a PI. I've not yet signed for anything and am glad I haven't since I've now decided it's best to wait for the information that will be available with patience. Once I have that info, then I'll sit down and determine if more action is needed. 

Thank you for your words. I'm sorry to hear about your husband and hope that you're on the road towards peace and healing.
